nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) _balances tracking token balances of holders in Core_Finance_Revamp.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowed storing ERC20 allowances.
uint256 _totalSupply initialized to 10000000000000000000000, mutated by mint/burn/transfer.
Public uint256 basePercent = 100 used by findOnePercentb fee/percent rounding math.
payable constructor of Core_Finance_Revamp that mints the whole _totalSupply to msg.sender.
transfer(address to, uint256 value) moves tokens from msg.sender to to and updates _totalSupply.
multiTransfer(address[] receivers, uint256[] amounts) loops over arrays and calls transfer for each entry.
approve(address spender, uint256 value) writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) moves tokens using _allowed[from][msg.sender].
increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) adds to the caller's allowance.
decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) subtracts from the caller's allowance.
Internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) increases balance of account and emits Transfer from address(0).
External burn(uint256 amount) destroys tokens from msg.sender by delegating to _burn.
Internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount) reduces balance and _totalSupply and emits Transfer to address(0).
External burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount) spends _allowed[account][msg.sender] and calls _burn.
Public view findOnePercentb(uint256 value) computes a rounded one-percent value using basePercent and SafeMath.ceil.
Public view returning _totalSupply.
Public view returning _balances[owner].
Public view returning _allowed[owner][spender].
Attacker-controlled caller address used as mapping index and authorization key across transfer/approve/transferFrom/burn paths.
SafeMath.sub arithmetic subtractions (balances, allowances, totalSupply); mapped to arithmetic.
SafeMath.add arithmetic additions for balances and allowances; mapped to arithmetic.
Rounding arithmetic chain ceil/add/sub/mul/div inside findOnePercentb; mapped to arithmetic.
Unbounded for-loop over receivers/amounts arrays in multiTransfer; array index access and gas/DoS surface.
address to parameter of transfer.
uint256 value parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve.
uint256 amount parameter of burn/_burn/burnFrom/_mint.
address account parameter of _mint/_burn/burnFrom.
address spender parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
uint256 addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance.
uint256 subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance.
address[] receivers parameter of multiTransfer.
uint256[] amounts parameter of multiTransfer.
address from parameter of transferFrom.
Local uint256 tokensToBurn computed by value.sub(0) in transfer/transferFrom.
Local uint256 tokensToTransfer computed as value minus burn amount.
Loop index uint256 i in multiTransfer.

edges.reason: transfer reads _balances[msg.sender] and _balances[to] through SafeMath operations.
transferFrom reads and updates _balances[from] and _balances[to].
transferFrom authorizes spending via _allowed[from][msg.sender] and decrements it.
approve directly overwrites _allowed[msg.sender][spender] without checks on the spender balance.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue into _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
_burn decrements _totalSupply by the burned amount.
transfer subtracts tokensToBurn (forced zero) from _totalSupply.
findOnePercentb uses basePercent for rounding and percentage computation.
msg.sender is the authorization subject whose _balances are debited in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the owner key when granting allowance in approve.
msg.sender is the spender key in _allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
burnFrom checks and spends _allowed[account][msg.sender], keyed by caller.
constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
burn destroys tokens held by msg.sender via _burn(msg.sender, amount).
constructor calls _mint(msg.sender, _totalSupply) to create the initial supply.
multiTransfer invokes transfer(receivers[i], amounts[i]) for each array element.
burn delegates the balance/supply mutation to internal _burn.
burnFrom delegates to internal _burn after spending allowance.
transfer performs value.sub(tokensToBurn) and _balances[msg.sender].sub(value).
transferFrom performs value.sub(tokensToBurn), _balances[from].sub(value) and allowance subtraction.
_burn performs _totalSupply.sub(amount) and _balances[account].sub(amount).
transfer performs _balances[to].add(tokensToTransfer).
_mint performs _balances[account].add(amount).
increaseAllowance performs allowance.add(addedValue).
decreaseAllowance performs allowance.sub(subtractedValue).
findOnePercentb chains ceil/add/sub/mul/div percentage arithmetic over basePercent.
multiTransfer executes the unbounded receivers/amounts indexing loop.
transfer writes updated values back into _balances[msg.sender] and _balances[to].
transferFrom writes updated values back into _balances[from] and _balances[to].
_burn writes the reduced balance back to _balances[account].
_mint writes the increased balance into _balances[account].
approve writes value into _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom subtracts the spent value from _allowed[from][msg.sender].
increaseAllowance stores the new allowance in _allowed.
decreaseAllowance stores the new allowance in _allowed.
_burn writes the reduced _totalSupply back to the state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: the destination address is only consumed by transfer and holds no independent semantics.
the value parameter is a bound argument of transfer's balance arithmetic.
the burn amount is the entry argument threaded from burn into _burn.
account is the balance holder mutated by the _burn routine.
spender identifies the allowance key written by approve.
addedValue is the increment operand of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is the decrement operand of decreaseAllowance.
receivers is the array iterated by multiTransfer.
amounts is the parallel array consumed by multiTransfer.
from is the debited owner address used by transferFrom.
tokensToBurn is a transient local always evaluated to zero inside transfer.
tokensToTransfer is the intermediate amount credited by transfer.
i is only the iteration counter of the multiTransfer loop.
